instruction.name: movgr2frh.w
instruction.description: Move the low 32 bits of rj into the high 32 bits of fd.

experiments.name: register round trip
experiments.notes: Register round trip measured at 5.01 cycles; subtracting the 2-cycle movfrh2gr.s leaves 3. Every closed chain crosses the boundary both ways, so the split between the two directions is a microarchitectural choice, not an independent measurement.

latencies.notes: rj -> fd. The chain closes through fst.d/ld.d; its 11.88-cycle cost is calibrated by replacing the move with movgr2fr.w (2 cycles). Raw spread 12.99-13.07 cycles. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0. Raw value was 1.14 cycles; the recorded nominal value is the nearest whole cycle, matching the repository convention.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; movgr2frh.w $f1, $r5; movgr2frh.w $f2, $r6; movgr2frh.w $f3, $r7; movgr2frh.w $f4, $r8; movgr2frh.w $f5, $r9; movgr2frh.w $f6, $r10; movgr2frh.w $f7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; movgr2frh.w $f1, $r5; movgr2frh.w $f2, $r6; movgr2frh.w $f3, $r7; movgr2frh.w $f4, $r8; movgr2frh.w $f5, $r9; movgr2frh.w $f6, $r10; movgr2frh.w $f7, $r11'

notes: movgr2frh.w is 3 cycles. Measured as a closed register round trip with the opposite direction subtracted; the round trip is additive with known-latency instructions inserted in between. Every cross-domain move on LA464 is 2 cycles per direction, with movgr2frh.w at 3 and the flag pair at 7/15 cycles. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
